🐕Elon Musk Clarifies: No Dogecoin Integration in U.S. Department of Government Efficiency (D.O.G.E.)

Elon Musk confirms that despite the fun acronym, the U.S. Department of Government Efficiency (D.O.G.E.) won't be using Dogecoin. He squashes rumors at a town hall, saying https://t.co/Y3iaibmSNw
